notes: MS3 evaluation dataset. 'core' is the approved regression set the >=95% final accuracy target is measured on; 'challenge' cases are deliberately adversarial or multi-trade and are reported separately so they can neither flatter nor depress the headline number. Labels for case-001..case-024 were frozen before the MS3 baseline run and have not been edited since. Cases 049/050/053/054/060 had their scripted-answer keyword coverage widened, and case-062's label was corrected, after the first v2 run — all documented in prod-MS3-report.md. Cases 071-083 are the locksmith<->handyman door boundary stress set added during MS3 review; they carry expectsClarification to assert that an under-specified description must produce a question rather than a guess. Cases 090-094 are a HELD-OUT door generalisation set: phrasings deliberately absent from both the boundary rule text and the 071-083 tuning cases. | classification-v5 added cases 101-115: out-of-catalogue trades labelled with the sentinel expectedCategory='unsupported', plus supported specialist trades (fridge/washing-machine/oven/boiler technicians) that must NOT be reported unsupported, plus one gas-vs-boiler borderline that must ask rather than dead-end. Unsupported cases are scored by EvaluationReport.unsupportedAccuracy() and forcedIntoSupportedCategory(), separately from headline accuracy.
